    Dell 14-16 Ecoloop Backpack - CP3724

Overview

    Sustainably made. Packed with protection.

    The Dell EcoLoop Essenti al Backpack reduces our environmental impact and protects your tech gear and essentials wherever you work.

    Designed with the environment in mind

    The Dell EcoLoop label identifies products that are manufactured with select materials and/or processes that help reduce our environmental impact.

    Responsible dyeing process

    Made with a solution-dyeing process for polyester that can generate up to 97% less greenhouse gas emissions, water impact and fossil fuels than traditional dyeing processes.

    100% recycled plastic

    Developed consciously with an environmentally friendly design, the exterior main fabric of this backpack is made with 100% recycled polyester that can utilize up to 90% less fossil fuels than virgin polyesterand reuses approximately 8 plastic bottles.

    100% recycled packaging

    The carrying case comes in packaging that's made with 100% recycled content in the hang tag, hang loop and plastic bag.

    Protection on-the-go

    Protect your tech

    The backpack provides protection on-the-go with 360º foam cushioning surrounding the laptop sleeve. It's made from durable fabric that makes it water-resistant to keep your belongings dry and protected.

    Tested for durability

    Our carrying cases are put through rigorous quality tests, including water resistance, strap and zipper strength and fabric abrasion, proving their sturdiness and long-lasting durability for the protection of your belongings.

    Be seen

    Enjoy a safe commute with reflective accents on the bag which increase visibility during low light hours.

    Thoughtfully designed

    Bring your office anywhere

    Store files, documents and other work essentials in the large capacity, full-access front opening main compartment complete with purpose-built organizers for increased functionality.

    Organize your essentials

    Secure your water bottle or umbrella in the stretchy mesh pockets on either side of the bag. Use the front zipper pocket for quick-access to your phone, wallet or other smaller accessories.

    Carry with ease

    Comfortably carry your office essentials in this lightweight backpack featuring a convenient grab handle, adjustable, padded shoulder straps and a padded back panel. A padded, dedicated laptop sleeve keeps your tech safe from knocks and bumps.
